notes: Only accepted ordinary CHECK/STOP displacement counts. ROLE_MOVE is intention only.
Distance is floored Euclidean endpoint displacement, capped at 64 per report; it is not verified path length.
One check at most per accepted position version. Stationary reports and movement inside the same 16px cell do not add distance.
Safe maps, portal transfer offers, loading, dead actors, teams and special movement must be excluded by trusted host eligibility.
No original monster.dat region semantics, encounter probability, formation, level formula or enemy stats are claimed.
No catch operation or drop table is enabled by a template catchable flag.
